## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should preserve the revision identifier used by history and completion output so deployments remain identifiable across those views.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment status with a shortened revision and attempt number. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Preserve the 12-character revision in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status()` displays `0123456` instead of `0123456789ab`. The seven-character slice contradicts its documented promise to use history’s identifier, which `history()` derives with `revision[:12]`. — Running deployments with revisions longer than seven characters lose the shared identifier used to correlate their history and completion output.
